title: QwenVLConnector: A Fast, Unified Medical VLM Chatbot for Fine-Grained Clinical Perception and Text Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.23139v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most medical vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended report generation and VQA but provide limited support for structured, fine-grained clinical perception within a unified interface. We present QwenVLConnector, a Qwen2.5-VL-based medical chatbot that unifies classification, multi-label classification, textualized detection, counting, regression, and free-form report generation under a single next-token objective. Our key component is a lightweight dense multi-layer Connector that aggregates low- and high-level visual features, aligns them through the pretrained vision Merger, and fuses them with the final visual representation without increasing sequence length. This design enriches visual tokens with complementary spatial and semantic cues while preserving efficiency. On FLARE-2D, QwenVLConnector improves detection F1 from 0.55 to 0.85, raises single-label classification from 0.37 to 0.51, and boosts report-generation GREEN

translated_title: QwenVLConnector：一个用于细粒度临床感知与文本生成的快速统一医学视觉语言模型聊天机器人
translated_abstract: 大多数医学视觉语言模型（VLM）擅长开放式报告生成和视觉问答（VQA），但在统一界面下对结构化、细粒度临床感知的支持有限。我们提出了QwenVLConnector，一个基于Qwen2.5-VL的医学聊天机器人，它在单一的next-token预测目标下统一了分类、多标签分类、文本化检测、计数、回归和自由格式报告生成任务。我们的关键组件是一个轻量级的密集多层Connector，它聚合低层和高层视觉特征，通过预训练的视觉Merger进行对齐，并将它们与最终视觉表示融合，且不增加序列长度。这种设计在保持效率的同时，用互补的空间和语义线索丰富了视觉token。在FLARE-2D数据集上，QwenVLConnector将检测F1分数从0.55提升到0.85，将单标签分类性能从0.37提升到0.51，并提升了报告生成的GREEN分数。
tldr: 提出基于Qwen2.5-VL的医学聊天机器人QwenVLConnector，通过轻量级多层Connector在单一next-token目标下统一分类、检测、计数、回归和报告生成等多种细粒度临床感知任务，在FLARE-2D上显著提升检测F1（0.55→0.85）和分类性能。
en_tdlr: QwenVLConnector, a Qwen2.5-VL-based medical chatbot, unifies classification, detection, counting, regression, and report generation under a single next-token objective via a lightweight multi-layer Connector, significantly improving detection F1 (0.55→0.85) and classification performance on FLARE-2D.
